Spaghetti Bolognese Recipe
Yield: 6 servings

1 lb spaghetti
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 onion, finely diced
1 carrot, finely diced
1 celery stalk, finely diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
500 g ground beef
2 tbsp tomato paste
½ cup red wine
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp dried oregano
1 bay leaf
½ cup grated parmesan, to serve
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
Fresh basil, to serve

Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the beef and brown it, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in the tomato paste, then the wine, and let it bubble for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and bay leaf and simmer for 45 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and serve with parmesan and basil.
